raw_text: Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant reportedly hit by Lazarus Group malware. The intrusion was on the administrative network, not the operational technology side which is air-gapped. Still, the fact that a DPRK-linked APT got into a nuclear facility's network is deeply concerning. Anyone know if this is related to the earlier Kudankulam incident from 2019?
clean_text: Discussion of Lazarus Group malware at Kudankulam Nuclear Plant. Administrative network compromised, OT air-gapped. Concerns about DPRK-linked APT targeting nuclear facility.
